sources.role: config/save/state path resolution (canonical upstream is Mercurial)
config file location, no BIOS requirement

paths.path: ~/.config/blastem/blastem.cfg (falls back to bundled default.cfg next to the executable when absent; ui config_in_exe_dir on relocates it to the exe dir); the config is the tern tree serialized as nested name { key value } blocks
paths.naming: Controller bindings use the tern-tree `bindings pads <SDL device index>` blocks: `dpads <n> <direction>`, `buttons <n>`, and `axes <n>.positive|negative` target `gamepads.<1-8>.<button>`; the config serialization is nested `name { key value }`
evidence: README:Configuration "$HOME/.config/blastem/blastem.cfg ... Otherwise it is read from default.cfg from the same directory as the BlastEm executable"

paths.path: ~/.local/share/blastem/<ROMNAME>/ — the ui save_path template, default "$USERDATA/blastem/$ROMNAME" with $USERDATA = ~/.local/share; NOT written alongside the ROM (verified against the pinned source)
paths.naming: Per-ROM directory named for the ROM's base name containing save.sram (SRAM), save.eeprom (I2C), save.nor (NOR flash) or save.hbpt; Sega CD/32X CD backup RAM persists as internal.bram / cart.bram in the same tree

paths.path: Same per-ROM save directory (~/.local/share/blastem/<ROMNAME>/): menu or ui.save_state (backtick by default) writes the quicksave slot
paths.naming: slot_0.state through slot_9.state plus quicksave.state with the default native format (state_format native); setting state_format gst writes Genecyst-compatible slot_N.gst / quicksave.gst, which the loader still accepts for Genesis
evidence: source:saves.c get_slot_name slot_%d.<ext> / quicksave.<ext> with "state" and legacy "gst" extensions
README:ui.save_state "Saves a savestate to the quicksave slot"

paths.path: None required — BlastEm boots cartridge ROMs directly (the ROM is a bare argument) with no firmware step; the pinned contract and upstream docs list no BIOS
paths.naming: No external BIOS or firmware filename; BlastEm boots the cartridge ROM directly, so no canonical checksum applies
evidence: contract:docs/BLASTEM_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md ("blastem.c main takes the ROM as a bare argument")

linux.notes: Lunchbox isolates BlastEm with a private HOME, which relocates both ~/.config/blastem and ~/.local/share/blastem into the session directory.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/com.retrodev.blastem/.config/blastem/blastem.cfg (paths.c keys everything off $HOME, which flatpak points at the per-app ~/.var/app dir)
paths.naming: Same tern-tree controller grammar as native: `bindings pads <SDL device index>` with `dpads`, `buttons`, and `axes` entries targeting `gamepads.<1-8>.<button>`
save.sram / save.eeprom / save.nor / save.hbpt inside the per-ROM directory; internal.bram / cart.bram for Sega CD backup RAM
slot_0.state ... slot_9.state and quicksave.state (or .gst when state_format gst)
